data.name: Hotel Flamingo All Inclusive
data.address: Blvd. Kukulcan km 11.5, Punta Cancun, Zona Hotelera, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Overlooking a beach along the Caribbean Sea, this upscale hotel is 1.3 km from Interactive Aquarium Cancún and 15 km from downtown Cancún.
The refined rooms include flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. Upgraded rooms offer sea views and/or swim-up access. Suites add sitting areas, pull-out sofas, and terraces with hot tubs. Room service is available.
Amenities include a chic lobby bar, and 2 restaurants with sea views, as well as 2 outdoor pools and a low-key poolside snack bar. There's also a fitness room, a kids' club and an outdoor play area, plus a spa and live entertainment. Breakfast and beach access are available.
